falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 closes above the 200-day moving average by more than 3% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A strong bullish breakout would invalidate the HOLD signal and suggest a trend reversal rather than a consolidation phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 80 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 80 would confirm a blowoff top pattern, directly contradicting the current HOLD verdict and indicating a confirmed topping phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: The pattern match percentage drops below 50% similarity to mini_top_2019_jun within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A significant divergence from the historical pattern would invalidate the current analysis, as the foundational similarity required for the verdict would no longer hold.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
